static_traits.name: Zhou Li
static_traits.social_status: Relationship with friends is somewhat tense (often cancels plans with friends to prioritize fishing)
static_traits.medical_history: without重要躯体疾病；既往without相似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、合作态度积极；能识do not并描述自己的僵化思维

basic_info.main_problem: 每到周末若只能钓鱼一天而without法两天都去，就会持续感到失望和沮丧，觉得周末被“毁了”，产生not满足与错失感；自从几个月前因工作取消一次钓鱼后愈发加重。
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of disappointment affect my overall mood and my enjoyment of weekends; I hope counseling can reduce the disappointment and increase the pleasure and flexibility of my weekends.

core_beliefs: Only by completing the weekend's two days of fishing as planned does my weekend have value
If the plan is disrupted, the whole experience equals failure

special_situations.event: On weekends, due to work arrangements or other matters, can only fish for one day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能两天都去钓鱼，这个周末就have not意义
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Prioritizes fishing, squeezing or canceling other activities as much as possible to increase fishing time

special_situations.event: 因工作承诺not得not取消一次原定的钓鱼行程
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果计划被打乱，就说明这个周末注定not开心
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to rearrange my schedule and move other arrangements as much as possible to non-fishing times to maintain the rules
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次周末not会好，以后也很难享受

special_situations.event: Busy weekend schedule and other commitments reducing fishing time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能把周末完全用于钓鱼，我就会失去放松与享受
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing plans with friends, arranging weekends more around fishing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我一定会错过最重要的享受

special_situations.event: 朋友提出与钓鱼冲突的活动邀请
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not选择钓鱼，就等于牺牲周末的质量
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Cancels activities with friends, prioritizing and securing the fishing arrangement
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 其他活动都not值得，我还是会not开心

core_conflict.wish: Desiring to gain relaxation and satisfaction through stable, controllable weekend fishing
core_conflict.fear: Fears that after the plan is disrupted, the weekend loses meaning; feels intense disappointment and loss
defense_goal: 维持刚性周末规则以降低Anxiety
Prioritizes fishing and avoids other arrangements to secure a sense of control

object_relations.self_representation: Self that needs established rules in order to relax and feel satisfied
object_relations.object_representation: 朋友（他人）not理解我的需求、外部承诺会夺走我的快乐

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When a friend's invitation conflicts with fishing time, or work arrangements disrupt weekend plans
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将任何变化理解为会“毁掉”周末的享受（把变动视为负面、not可承受）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Refusing others' invitations on the grounds of emphasizing the schedule and needing to relax, in a calm but firm tone, prioritizing ensuring the fishing plan.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当听到他人表示“not理解为何错过一天钓鱼会如此沮丧”
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为他人普遍not理解自己并可能轻视自己的感受（移情：将not被理解的感受赋予他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes others' attitudes and opinions, downplays exploration of their own rigid rules; uses defensive statements to protect existing arrangements.

manifestations: 当周末not能两天钓鱼时，体验被定义为“被毁了”、“not值得”
Ties the meaning of the weekend solely to the single activity of fishing
outcomes: 对其他活动丧失动力与兴趣

manifestations: 为优先钓鱼而取消与朋友的计划
感到朋友并not理解自己为何如此沮丧
Bound by rigid weekend rules, hard to respond flexibly to changes
Treats 'must fish for two days' as a rigid standard
outcomes: 选择弹性下降、心理灵活性受限
适应变动的能力减弱而增加压力

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Uses 'must fish two days', 'the weekend will otherwise be ruined' as rigid self-standards
难以容许计划的差异与变动

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 觉得朋友not理解、甚至可能轻视自己的感受
Attributes the inner experience of being misunderstood to others' attitudes

positive_force: Holds a positive attitude toward counseling and is willing to practice reframing 'rules as wishes'
Has other interests (hiking, reading) that can serve as alternative activity resources
工作表现not yet受影响，基本生活稳定
能够识do not自身的非黑即白与僵化思维模式
negative_force: Has rigid rules and black-and-white thinking about weekend activities
过度将周末价值绑定在钓鱼上，negate其他积极体验
常取消与朋友的计划以优先钓鱼，导致Interpersonal tension
When plans are disrupted, tending to catastrophize and evaluate them as 'ruined'
对错失的担忧与执着加重失望感与Decreased drive

target_behavior.behavior: When weekend plans are disrupted, strong disappointment and frustration appear, repeatedly concluding 'the weekend is ruined'
antecedent: 工作承诺或其他事务导致not能两天都去钓鱼
朋友的活动邀请与钓鱼时间冲突
周末安排繁忙、计划被打乱
target_behavior.core_reason: Holds a rigid all-or-nothing rule about the weekend experience, binding the weekend's meaning solely to fishing
target_behavior.function: 维持控制感、逃避not确定与变化带来的Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 整体Low mood、对其他活动缺乏动力与兴趣，主观周末满意度下降

target_behavior.behavior: Frequently cancels plans with friends to prioritize fishing
antecedent: 朋友邀请与钓鱼安排冲突
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries that missing fishing will lose the weekend's relaxation and satisfaction, regarding fishing as the only key activity
target_behavior.function: 获得更多钓鱼时间与掌控感，避免面对计划变动带来的not适
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension、Reduced social support，进一步加重周末的not满足感
